Build is clean. The error was on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`. Changed it to `env.retries || 1` to read the retry count from the parameter with a fallback default.

The three warnings (deprecated crypto API, unused export, circular import) remain, but they're not breaking the build. All 0 errors, 41.7 seconds, exit code 0.
